So I want to know whether it is permissible to keep the fathers name next to the childrens' name for e.g. Ammara Imran or Talha Imran Question: I am expecting a baby very soon. So I want to know whether it is permissible to keep the fathers name next to the childrens' name for e.g. Ammara Imran or Talha Imran. Answer ID: 36257 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 270/152/D=1433) Yes, you can keep it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
